decisions.reason: This naval vessel lighting system builds on the firm's strong specialist-lighting, compliance and testing capabilities, so despite its niche market management would likely retain it and learn from early deployments.

A spring-balanced desk lamp fits the firm's ergonomic and application-specific lighting know-how and having its own page suggests enough commitment to justify continued refinement rather than withdrawal.
A general interior lighting luminaire sits at the heart of the firm's established knowledge base and the visible G2 iteration indicates active learning and improvement, making withdrawal unlikely.

A pendant luminaire with microprismatic optics is closely related to the firm's core office and building-lighting expertise, so management would usually keep it as a technically familiar extension of the range.

Although marine search applications are related to the firm's specialist-lighting capabilities, an HMI searchlight is less aligned with its move toward sustainable and intelligent lighting, so management is comparatively likely to discontinue it.
